mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce discount rates for equity valuation and stimulate economic activity.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is not negative (>= 0) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 4.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy and increasing the risk of economic slowdown, which depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong labor market growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 4.0%) triggers a monetary policy tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 50% of instances when both PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is not negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (characterized by strong but slowing GDP growth), the S&P 500 tends to underperform in the following 20 trading days as the economy approaches a peak and the risk of recession increases.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is not negative.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as strong labor conditions support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between UNRATE and 20-day forward returns is not negative (>= 0) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly HOUST reading below 1.3 million units signals weak housing market conditions, indicating broader demand weakness and potential economic slowdown, which depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1300, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in housing starts (HOUST < 1300) and retail sales (RSAFS < 680000 million dollars) signals a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 50% of instances when both HOUST < 1300 and RSAFS < 680000, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is not negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (characterized by declining industrial production), the S&P 500 tends to underperform in the following 60 trading days as supply constraints disrupt economic activity and corporate margins.
failure_condition: In the supply shock regime, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is not negative.
